changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1: a crossfader between two groups of tracks and inputs.
Source-only export compiled in the pinned GCC 16.2 Docker toolchain; it links to the same image (CF01, 3419f572…) as the locally compiled recipe used for the emulator checks.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
